root_cause.text: The XFS log initialization code hardcoded a default log roundoff value of 512 bytes (BBSIZE) when no log stripe unit is specified, ignoring the log sector size (sb_logsectsize), which can be larger (e.g., 4096 bytes) and must be used as the minimum alignment unit to avoid log corruption.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `xlog_alloc_log` to add an additional check: if `sb_logsunit > 1` is false but `sb_logsectsize > 0`, then use `sb_logsectsize` for `l_iclog_roundoff`; otherwise fall back to `BBSIZE`. This directly addresses the missing case where the log sector size should have been used.
